findings.title: Pending idempotent replays exit with success
findings.evidence: Claim event in a still-live process and invoke CLI run with identical payload: status=received, no output exists, exit code=0.
findings.suggestion: Return a documented pending code or wait for terminal result.

findings.title: Schema TypeError bypasses JSON error contract or is misclassified
findings.evidence: CLI route task_type=42 emits traceback with empty stdout and exit1; run state.constraints string returns failed/execution_failed at validate stage.
findings.suggestion: Treat TypeError from validation as rejected and include it in CLI error handling.

findings.title: Retained XLSX rich text loses formatting despite verified success
findings.evidence: Source B2 CellRichText with bold/italic runs becomes plain str in output. Verification reports retained_metadata_preserved=true.
findings.suggestion: Reject unsupported rich text or preserve and independently verify rich-text runs.

findings.title: Cross-origin simple POST mutates loopback service state
findings.evidence: Own temporary loopback server accepted Origin=https://untrusted.example Content-Type=text/plain POST /skills/state with HTTP200 and disabled CSV skill.
findings.suggestion: Reject untrusted Origin and require application/json for POST.

findings.title: Launcher dependency probe may create interpreter bytecode caches
findings.evidence: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE is set only for command execution on line7, after openpyxl import in candidate probe.
findings.suggestion: Apply -B or PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 to candidate probe.

residual_risks: Crash recovery uses PID liveness only; PID reuse may leave a stale received/running record.
Killed process can leave an owned .rpe-* staging file; stage path and inode are only in process memory.
No proof of Excel formula values; only supported formula structures preserved by design.
Real browser network permission policies may block the cross-origin request; server does not enforce this boundary itself.
